title: Cornell faculty senate introduces no-confidence resolution over handling of alleged 2024 sexual assault - NBC News
description: ITHACA, N.Y. — Cornell University faculty introduced a resolution declaring a no-confidence vote in the university administration’s handling of the alleged 2024 sexual assault at a fraternity house.
